# Immutable cache entries (first-write-wins)

When inserting a cache row, the code only adds a new LLMCacheRow if session.get(LLMCacheRow, key) returns None; existing entries are not overwritten.

Preserve immutability of cached outputs so that the first stored answer for a key remains authoritative.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/cache.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.cache.LLMCache.put`
